say:2:1522216001:1.text: Sir, how can you back out now?!
say:2:1522216001:1.source_cn: 副将大人，您怎么能突然变卦呢？

say:3:1522216002:0.text: You promised! You and Lady Tella agreed—whenever Perseus wasn't in the city, we'd stage a food grab during the relief handouts, then <style="highlight">"donate" the goods to the army</style> for the war effort—
say:3:1522216002:0.source_cn: 您之前不是都和忒拉大人商量好了吗？只要放赈灾粮的时候统...

say:4:1522216003:1.text:
I said shut up!
I don't care what Tella told you. Keep your mouth shut!
say:4:1522216003:1.source_cn: ——闭嘴！\n不管忒拉交代你去做什么事，都给我把嘴闭严了！

say:5:1522216004:0.text: If you keep running it like that, I'll be coming to your house next to seize your private stash!
say:5:1522216004:0.source_cn: 要是嘴上再没个看门的，什么事都往外抖，就等着我上门没收...

say:6:1522216005:0.text: I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I wasn't thinking—
say:6:1522216005:0.source_cn: 对不起，对不起！都是我的错，全是我失言……

say:7:1522216006:1.text: But... what do we do about the relief food now?
say:7:1522216006:1.source_cn: 但是，赈灾粮的事……之后该怎么做？

say:8:1522216007:1.text: That shipment came from the Regulus himself. Even Perseus approved it!
say:8:1522216007:1.source_cn: 赈灾粮是领主下令增设，珀尔修斯也同意了的！

say:9:1522216008:1.text: The city is starving... We're not taking any more of their food. No matter how badly the army needs it.
say:9:1522216008:1.source_cn: 城内平民的情况也不容乐观……别再和他们抢赈灾粮了。作战...

say:10:1522216009:0.text: And listen up, Perseus is in the city right now. If he catches wind of what we tried today, you're done for. Halia will spit you out.
say:10:1522216009:0.source_cn: 而且珀尔修斯现在就在城内，消息灵通着点！今天这事要是被...

say:11:1522216010:1.text: Why are you so scared of him, sir?
say:11:1522216010:1.source_cn: 副将大人，您何必这么怕统帅？

say:12:1522216011:1.text: Lady Tella's covering us. He can't pin it on you.
say:12:1522216011:1.source_cn: 筹集军粮的事有忒拉大人顶着，肯定不会牵连到您身上，他没...

say:13:1522216012:0.text: And it's his fault we're short on supplies anyway! He's been dragging his feet on the assault. We're out of options because of him!
say:13:1522216012:0.source_cn: 再说了，要不是他一直拖着不肯发动总攻，拖到粮草都不够了...

say:14:1522216013:0.text: And that little Wildborn girl... was she brought here by the general himself? Is he seriously trying to make peace with the Wildborn—
say:14:1522216013:0.source_cn: 还有刚刚那个小兽人……那是统帅大人带回来的？难道他想促...

say:16:1522216015:0.text: You dare bring up the Wildborn? It's bad enough we had to brawl over food in broad daylight! Think about how much of a fool you've made of both of us!
say:16:1522216015:0.source_cn: 你还敢提兽人？光天化日之下争抢粮食叫外人笑话也就算了，...

say:17:1522216016:0.text: Supplies will be handled. You don't get to stick your nose in it. Now get out of my sight!
say:17:1522216016:0.source_cn: 粮草的事自有计议，轮不到你在这里搅浑水！滚！
